alt_text.1: HXG title slide introducing the thesis that the in-room display is becoming an experience-orchestration layer.
alt_text.2: Three statistics from J.D. Power: 74 percent availability, 62 percent usage, and a 44,787-person sample.
alt_text.3: A six-spoke wheel places human experience at the center of feeling at home, in control, recognized, included, secure, and supported.
alt_text.4: Human value and property value are separated, with property-specific formulas for ancillary contribution, energy, and support savings.
alt_text.5: Six stakeholder groups surround the connected display ecosystem, with their distinct value mechanisms and an economic-context caveat.
alt_text.6: A clearly labeled vendor-stated Samsung reference architecture with seven components and availability limitations.
alt_text.7: Three evidence states—direct fact, supported inference, and modeled scenario—plus four major contradiction-audit findings.
alt_text.8: Methodology slide lists eight research stages, generated release counts, the public explorer URL, and a QR code only after live verification.
